title: artemisia marschalliana subsp. tschernieviana
intro: Artemisia marschalliana subsp. tschernieviana, commonly known as Marschall's sage, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Marschall's sage include relaxing the muscles, reducing pain and inflammation, and improving respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
